spans.s:
The affix अण् comes after a root with the force of the future when the word in construction with it is in the Accusative -2nd case and when the action is performed for the sake of another action.

Terms: अण्

The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'he conveys' after the word कुटिलिका in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction.

Terms: अण्

The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'its law' after the word महिषी etc.

Terms: ठक्

And also अण् comes after तपस् and सहर।

Terms: अण्
